text: Using an auxiliary confidence loss on the strong student (aux_loss_weight 0.5), we trained qwen2.5-3b on labels from a gpt2-large weak supervisor and measured weak-to-strong generalization across 5 seeds. The weak supervisor reaches 0.45 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling, when trained on ground-truth labels, is 0.63. The confidence-loss student attains transfer accuracy of 0.60 (SE 0.01) and a performance gap recovered of 0.85 (SE 0.01), compared with a baseline PGR of 0.49. The margin over the baseline is far larger than two standard errors of the PGR estimate, so the improvement is well supported by the five seeds available, though no standard error is reported for the baseline itself, which limits a formal comparison. It is worth noting that the absolute transfer accuracy of 0.60 still falls short of the 0.63 strong ceiling, so the high PGR reflects a narrow weak-to-strong gap rather than ceiling-level performance.
